name: Centennial College
description: Centennial College is Ontario’s first public college with five campuses in Toronto, Canada. Centennial offers high-quality Canadian Education that is hands-on and employment-focused. Programs at Centennial promote experiential learning with laboratory instruction, co-op education, internship placements, and real-life industry projects. Centennial has an international reputation as one of Canada’s top research colleges, top-tier institutional ratings for academic quality, and outstanding rankings in student satisfaction. Centennial offers over 200 innovative online and hybrid programs, including foundations, post-secondary and post-graduate options.
